description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for membership search filter parameters within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and sets a default sort field.

classes.name: MembershipSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating search filter parameters for memberships, including default sorting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters, particularly setting the default sort field to 'm.name'.
